records.jp: ひまわり見ると、夏ーって感じするよね
records.en_original: Sunflowers always make me think of summer.
records.en: Sunflowers always make me think of summer.

records.jp: するー！　見てるこっちも元気になるっていうか<CR>ほんと、太陽みたいな花だよね
records.en_original: I know what you mean! Just looking at them cheers me up. The flowers themselves look like the sun.
records.en: I know what you mean! Just looking at them cheers me up. The flowers themselves look like the sun.

records.jp: うん、陽桜莉さんみたい
records.en_original: Yeah. Just like you, Hiori.
records.en: Yeah. Just like you, Hiori.

records.jp: え、私？
records.en_original: Huh, me?
records.en: Huh, me?

records.jp: いつも元気いっぱいだから
records.en_original: You're always bursting with energy!
records.en: You're always bursting with energy!

records.jp: それは、愛央ちゃんも同じだよ
records.en_original: But so are you, Ao.
records.en: But so are you, Ao.

records.jp: 私、いっつも愛央ちゃんに元気もらってるもん
records.en_original: You're always cheer me up.
records.en: You're always cheer me up.

records.jp: じゃあ、その元気を私がまた陽桜莉さんから<CR>もらってるわけだ
records.en_original: Well that's just because of all the positive energy I get from you.
records.en: Well that's just because of all the positive energy I get from you.

records.jp: ……あれ？<CR>そうなると、どっちの元気になるんだろ？
records.en_original: ...Wait, then who's cheering up whom, exactly?
records.en: ...Wait, then who's cheering up whom, exactly?

records.jp: むむむむ～？
records.en_original: Hmmmm...?
records.en: Hmmmm...?

records.jp: （悩ませてしまった……）
records.en_original: (Oops, guess I confused her...)
records.en: (Oops, guess I confused her...)

records.jp: みんなを明るく照らしてくれるから
records.en_original: You shine your light on everyone around you.
records.en: You shine your light on everyone around you.

records.jp: そう、なのかな？
records.en_original: I do? Really?
records.en: I do? Really?

records.jp: うん。陽桜莉さんの側にいると<CR>自然と笑顔になれるっていうか……
records.en_original: Yeah. Everyone's all smiles whenever you're around.
records.en: Yeah. Everyone's all smiles whenever you're around.

records.jp: この人と一緒にいれば、大丈夫！<CR>みたいな、気持ちになるよ
records.en_original: It's like you have this aura that says, "as long as you're with me, everything will be just fine!"
records.en: It's like you have this aura that says, "as long as you're with me, everything will be just fine!"

records.jp: えへへ……<CR>それはちょっと、褒めすぎかな
records.en_original: Hehe... I think that's a little much.
records.en: Hehe... I think that's a little much.

records.jp: でも、ありがとう！<CR>愛央ちゃんに、そう言われると嬉しいなあ
records.en_original: But I'm happy to hear you say that! Thanks, Ao!
records.en: But I'm happy to hear you say that! Thanks, Ao!

records.jp: いえいえ、どういたしまして
records.en_original: Don't mention it!
records.en: Don't mention it!

records.jp: ふふっ……！
records.en_original: Hehe...
records.en: Hehe...

records.jp: ……そういえば、花占いってやったことある？
records.en_original: ...By the way, have you ever tried that "she loves me, she loves me not" game?
records.en: ...By the way, have you ever tried that "she loves me, she loves me not" game?

records.jp: 花占い？　ないかも？
records.en_original: Hmm, I don't think so.
records.en: Hmm, I don't think so.

records.jp: せっかくだから、やってみようよ。<CR>……あ、でも、花を千切るのはかわいそう
records.en_original: We should do it, then! Oh...but I feel bad tearing a flower apart.
records.en: We should do it, then! Oh...but I feel bad tearing a flower apart.

records.jp: 千切らないで<CR>数えながらやったらどうかな？
records.en_original: Why don't we just count the petals instead?
records.en: Why don't we just count the petals instead?

records.jp: あ、それいいね！　よーし！
records.en_original: Oh, good idea! Okay!
records.en: Oh, good idea! Okay!

records.jp: 好き、きらい、好き、きらい、好き……
records.en_original: She loves me, she loves me not, she loves me, she loves me not, she loves me...
records.en: She loves me, she loves me not, she loves me, she loves me not, she loves me...

records.jp: （ほんとに、数え始めた……<CR>ひまわりって、花びら何枚あるんだろう？）
records.en_original: (She's really counting them one by one... How many petals does a sunflower have?)
records.en: (She's really counting them one by one... How many petals does a sunflower have?)

records.jp: 好き、きらい、好き、きらい、好き……<CR>あれ、今どこまで数えたっけ？
records.en_original: She loves me, she loves me not, she loves me, she loves me not, she loves me... Wait, how far am I?
records.en: She loves me, she loves me not, she loves me, she loves me not, she loves me... Wait, how far am I?

records.jp: もういいんじゃないかな
records.en_original: Probably far enough?
records.en: Probably far enough?

records.jp: うぅ、でもあと少しだから！
records.en_original: Nooo, I'm almost there!
records.en: Nooo, I'm almost there!

records.jp: 好き、きらい、好き、きらい、好き、好き、<CR>好き、きらい、きらい、好き……
records.en_original: Loves me, loves me not, loves me, loves me not, loves me, loves me, loves me, loves me not, loves me not, loves me...
records.en: Loves me, loves me not, loves me, loves me not, loves me, loves me, loves me, loves me not, loves me not, loves me...

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、順番おかしくなってる
records.en_original: Hiori, you're getting them mixed up!
records.en: Hiori, you're getting them mixed up!

records.jp: あれぇぇ！？
records.en_original: Whaaaat?!
records.en: Whaaaat?!

records.jp: あと半分だよ！
records.en_original: You're halfway there!
records.en: You're halfway there!

records.jp: うん、がんばる！
records.en_original: Okay, gotta stay focused!
records.en: Okay, gotta stay focused!

records.jp: 好き、きらい、好き、きらい、好きっ……！
records.en_original: She loves me, she loves me not, she loves me, she loves me not, she loves me...!
records.en: She loves me, she loves me not, she loves me, she loves me not, she loves me...!

records.jp: 今、一枚飛ばした！
records.en_original: You skipped one!
records.en: You skipped one!

records.jp: えっ、ほんと！？　えと、えと、そしたら……
records.en_original: Huh? Really?! Um, uhh, let's see...
records.en: Huh? Really?! Um, uhh, let's see...

records.jp: 好きのところから！
records.en_original: Start from "she loves me"!
records.en: Start from "she loves me"!

records.jp: わかった！<CR>好き、きらい、好きっ…！
records.en_original: Okay! She loves me, she loves me not, she loves me...!
records.en: Okay! She loves me, she loves me not, she loves me...!

records.jp: はぁ～……<CR>結局、分かんなくなっちゃった
records.en_original: Aww... After all that, I still don't know.
records.en: Aww... After all that, I still don't know.

records.jp: ひまわりって、花びら多いからね
records.en_original: Sunflowers have a lot of petals.
records.en: Sunflowers have a lot of petals.

records.jp: （でも、今のって恋占いだよね？<CR>陽桜莉さん、誰と占ってたのかな）
records.en_original: (But I wonder who she was thinking about...)
records.en: (But I wonder who she was thinking about...)

records.jp: （あんまり、踏み込むのもよくないよね。<CR>黙っておこうっと）
records.en_original: (Probably shouldn't be nosy. I'll just keep my mouth shut.)
records.en: (Probably shouldn't be nosy. I'll just keep my mouth shut.)

records.jp: ……はあ～、答え知りたかったのになぁ
records.en_original: *Sigh* I really wanted to know the answer.
records.en: *Sigh* I really wanted to know the answer.

records.jp: 今度、図書室でひまわりの花の枚数<CR>調べてみよっか
records.en_original: Next time we're at the library, we can look up the number of petals a sunflower has.
records.en: Next time we're at the library, we can look up the number of petals a sunflower has.

records.jp: うん？
records.en_original: Hmm?
records.en: Hmm?

records.jp: 奇数か偶数かで、答えが分かるじゃん
records.en_original: That way, you'll know if the number is odd or even.
records.en: That way, you'll know if the number is odd or even.

records.jp: あっ、あー！！　そっかあ！
records.en_original: Oh yeah! You're right!
records.en: Oh yeah! You're right!

records.jp: うんうん、調べる！<CR>好きだといいなぁ……えへへ
records.en_original: Let's look it up! I hope the answer is "she loves me"... Hehe.
records.en: Let's look it up! I hope the answer is "she loves me"... Hehe.

records.jp: （いい笑顔……<CR>ううん、誰が相手か気になる！）
records.en_original: (She looks so happy... Ugh, I really wanna know who she's thinking of!)
records.en: (She looks so happy... Ugh, I really wanna know who she's thinking of!)

records.en_original: Who were you thinking about just now?
records.en: Who were you thinking about just now?

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんだよ
records.en_original: You, Ao.
records.en: You, Ao.

records.jp: へー……って、私！？
records.en_original: Oh... Wait, me?!
records.en: Oh... Wait, me?!

records.jp: うん。私のこと、好きかなー<CR>きらいかなーって思って！
records.en_original: Yeah. I wanted to know if you love me or love me not!
records.en: Yeah. I wanted to know if you love me or love me not!

records.jp: でも、答えは分かんなかったね。残念！
records.en_original: But I couldn't get an answer. What a shame!
records.en: But I couldn't get an answer. What a shame!

records.jp: いやいや、分かるでしょ！
records.en_original: That's not true, you know the answer!
records.en: That's not true, you know the answer!

records.jp: え、そうなの！？
records.en_original: I do?
records.en: I do?

records.jp: 本人、目の前にいるんだから<CR>直接聞けばよくない！？
records.en_original: And the person you're thinking of is right in front of you, why not just ask them?!
records.en: And the person you're thinking of is right in front of you, why not just ask them?!

records.jp: おお、たしかに！！
records.en_original: Ohh, good point!
records.en: Ohh, good point!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、私のこと好き？きらい？
records.en_original: Ao, do you love me? Or do you love me not?
records.en: Ao, do you love me? Or do you love me not?

records.jp: そりゃ、好きに決まってるよ！
records.en_original: Of course I love you!
records.en: Of course I love you!

records.jp: ほんと！？　えへへ……やった！
records.en_original: Really?! Ehehe... Yay!
records.en: Really?! Ehehe... Yay!

records.jp: 私も、愛央ちゃんのこと好きだよ
records.en_original: I love you too, Ao.
records.en: I love you too, Ao.

records.jp: う、うん、ありがとう
records.en_original: Th-thanks!
records.en: Th-thanks!

records.jp: えへへー
records.en_original: Teehee.
records.en: Teehee.

records.jp: （なんだろう、嬉しいけど……すごく照れる！）
records.en_original: (What is this... I'm happy, but also so embarrassed at the same time!)
records.en: (What is this... I'm happy, but also so embarrassed at the same time!)
